Split (6-day).title: Football + core
Split (6-day).note: Football match/training; proper core session alongside.

Split (6-day).title: Treadmill run + Push (chest & arms)
Split (6-day).note: Treadmill run for cardio volume (back rehab: outdoor running limited to Saturday for now), distance ramping weekly. Daily rehab routine (couch stretch, glute bridges etc.) done separately — do it before the run on run days. Then Push A.

Split (6-day).title: Pull + Legs
Split (6-day).note: Pull A + legs. Bulgarian split squats added for single-leg strength — targets the hip-extension weakness behind the outdoor-running back pain.

Split (6-day).title: Push (shoulders) + Treadmill run
Split (6-day).note: Push B. Treadmill run (back rehab: outdoor limited to Saturday). Daily rehab routine (couch stretch, glute bridges etc.) done separately — do it before the run.

Split (6-day).title: Pull (back & arms)
Split (6-day).note: Pull B, upper only. Moved from Sunday on 12 Sep 2026 so Sunday is the full rest day; legs stay on Saturday so Monday football starts fresh.

Split (6-day).title: Parkrun + core + Legs
Split (6-day).note: Parkrun 5 km is the week's ONE outdoor run — do the daily rehab routine (couch stretch, glute bridges etc.) before leaving, run slower than feels natural, short stride, high cadence, 'run tall, tuck the pelvis'. Cut it short if the back flares. Legs later in the day. Keep leg curls controlled, not maximal — hamstrings are run-fatigued.

Split (6-day).title: Rest
Split (6-day).note: Long walk + yoga (75-day challenge active-recovery day).

Full body (3-day).title: Full body A (push + pull + legs)
Full body (3-day).note: Heavy legs (6–8 reps on leg press). Pair incline press ⇄ chest-supported row and curl ⇄ pushdown as antagonist pairs with 60–90 s between. Lift earlier in the day; 5-a-side football in the evening. ~55–65 min.

Full body (3-day).title: Treadmill run
Full body (3-day).note: Treadmill run, distance ramping weekly toward the 10k goal. Daily rehab routine (couch stretch, glute bridges etc.) done separately — do it before the run.

Full body (3-day).title: Full body B (push + pull + legs)
Full body (3-day).note: Moderate legs. Dumbbell Romanian deadlift is new — progress it normally (strength and mobility are the rehab). Lateral raise ⇄ face pull as an accessory pair. ~55–65 min.

Full body (3-day).note: Light legs (12–15 reps on leg press, or hack squat if available). Machine chest press or dips ⇄ cable row; curl ⇄ overhead tricep extension. ~50–60 min.
